proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: shrink X to a quasi-compact neighbourhood of the support, take a perfect approximation P -> F of the triple (X, F, -1); the approximation identifies Hom(F, G) with Hom_D(P, G) both over X and after base change (right exactness of h^* plus positive-degree vanishing of P); the Leray spectral sequence rewrites the functor as H^0(T, Rf_{T,*}RSheafHom(P_T, G_T)), base change for perfect input identifies this with Lg^*K for K = Rf_*RSheafHom(P, G), perfectness of K follows from G flat with proper support, and negative-degree cohomology vanishing lets the perfect-complex representability lemma finish (source lines 820-881)

core_obligations: Approximation (proof lines 821-842): shrink to quasi-compact X, choose the perfect approximation P -> F; Hom(F_T, G_T) = Hom_D(P_T, G_T) over every base change since H^0(P_T) -> F_T is an isomorphism.
Leray rewriting (proof lines 844-857): the functor is T -> H^0(T, Rf_{T,*}RSheafHom(P_T, G_T)) via the Leray spectral sequence remark.
Base change and perfectness (proof lines 858-870): Rf_{T,*}RSheafHom(P_T, G_T) = Lg^*K with K = Rf_*RSheafHom(P, G) perfect by the cited lemma.
Conclusion (proof lines 870-881): negative cohomology of Lg^*K vanishes because RSheafHom(P_T, G_T) has no negative cohomology sheaves; apply the perfect-complex representability lemma.
proof_roadmap: Replace F by its perfect approximation (proof lines 821-842).
Rewrite the functor via Leray (proof lines 844-857).
Identify the pushed-forward complex as a perfect K with base change compatibility (proof lines 858-870).
Apply the representability lemma for perfect complexes (proof lines 870-881).
